name: vast-3090-c16
description: RTX 3090 (24 GB) on Vast.ai: C1/C2/C4/C8 batch scaling and output tok/s at 4K/16K/32K, IQ3_S RAM-tier with Q2_0 fallback. The installed Strata engine (0.1.52/0.1.53) rejects --parallel > 8 ('Use 1 to 8'), so C16 is NOT measured; the 2.88x C16 projection stays unvalidated.

estimate.basis: 113.2 GB download at $2.67/TB ($0.30) + 3 h at $0.176/h ($0.53) + disk; the 2026-10-25 host at $53.33/TB cost $3.80 for 73 GB and is excluded by max_down_cost_per_tb

caveats: The installed engine rejects --parallel 16 ('16 requests at once is outside what the engine can do. Use 1 to 8'). C16 is therefore NOT measurable in this engine: a 16-client test against 8 slots would be oversubscription (C8 throughput with queueing), not a C16 batch gain. The 2.88x projection remains unvalidated; a real C16 needs llama.cpp -np 16 or an engine change. This run measures C1..C8.
Memory is tight: 24 GB VRAM + 60-64 GB host = 84-88 GB against IQ3_S at 83.6 GB; KV at C16 is 51 MB at 4K and 410 MB at 32K. Q2_0 (66 GB) is the fallback if IQ3_S OOMs.
Always filter Vast offers on internet_down_cost_per_tb (<= $5/TB) and driver >= 580.65; the cheapest Quebec 3090s run driver 570.181 and are unusable.
No credit is consumed until the run is launched; the account must be recharged first (the previous 3090 attempt ended at -$0.78).
Per-stream at C16 is expected to fall below the 10 tok/s interactive floor even if aggregate wins; report both.
The engine also warns that 8 slots exceed what a 24 GB card usually holds (it fits ~3 at 32K); C8 at 32K may be slower than C8 at 4K/16K. Report both, do not extrapolate.
